heading: Tuesday, June 9, 2026
topLine: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5, its first public Mythos-class model.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5, its first public Mythos-class model
items.summary: Claude Fable 5 is a generally available Mythos-class model with safeguards. Claude Mythos 5 is the same underlying model with some safeguards lifted, limited to Project Glasswing partners. Anthropic claims state-of-the-art results on nearly all benchmarks it tested; both are priced at $10/$50 per million tokens.
